messages:
Maria V: FYI I opened a docs PR to add a containerized conn-checker example for air-gapped/private installs. It covers running the check inside a network namespace / container when hosts use IPv6 and MTU < 1500. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4721
Kevin L: Nice. Can you paste the minimal `docker run` snippet here? want to validate on our sealed-site test lab.
Maria V: Sure — here's the snippet I added to the `private/install/conn-checker.md` section:
```bash
# run from a bastion that has the airgap bundle mounted
docker run --rm --network none --cap-add=NET_ADMIN \
  -v /var/run/netns:/var/run/netns:ro \
  redwood/conn-checker:0.8.1 \
  --target https://kms.internal.example:8443 \
  --mtu 1400 --ipv6 --dns-fallback 2001:4860:4860::8888
```
Sahil R: I like that. A couple of quick asks: 1) add note about needing `CAP_NET_ADMIN` to manipulate MTU/netns, 2) mention that our conn-checker falls back to TCP for KMS if UDP is restricted.
Maria V: Added both as short bullets in the PR diff. Also included a small troubleshooting section on MTU pathology and `ip -6 route` checks.
Jen K: docs-bot flagged one link in the PR (internal KMS URL) as non-resolvable by the link checker, which is expected for sealed sites. We should add a directive to disable the check for that line in CI so the PR doesn't fail CI for sealed-site examples.
docs-bot: link-checker: found 1 unresolved link in private/install/conn-checker.md line 42 -> https://kms.internal.example:8443 (expected for sealed sites).
Kevin L: Agree on the CI exception. We already have a pattern for `<!-- linkcheck:skip -->` elsewhere; can you follow the same? Also add a short note that readers should replace the KMS host with their own endpoint.
Maria V: Will do. One more compatibility note: older HSM plugins that use PKCS#11 over the network need shelling out to the host namespace; added an example using `--pid=host --network=host` with a warning.
Sahil R: Can we keep that example separate? using host network in docs might scare reviewers. Maybe keep it in a troubleshooting annex and flag it as advanced/risk.
Maria V: Done — moved the host-network example into "Advanced: host-namespace fallback" section and added the risk warning.
deploy-bot: CI status: docs/build: succeeded for PR #4721 (linkcheck skipped for sealed-site patterns). :white_check_mark:
Jen K: Small nit — the sample uses `redwood/conn-checker:0.8.1`. We should add a compatibility matrix note for versions >=0.8.0 that introduced IPv6/MTU flags.
Maria V: Added compatibility table and a one-line migration note for users upgrading from 0.7.x.
Kevin L: I'll spin up a quick test in the sealed-site lab tomorrow morning and report results. If green, let's merge. :thumbsup:
Maria V: Thanks — will wait for your confirm, then merge and backport to the 1.2.x docs branch.
Sahil R: One follow-up: please include the `conn-checker --debug` sample output snippet — it's super helpful for support.
Maria V: Added a minimal debug log example to the troubleshooting annex.
Jen K: Great thread. Leaving a :eyes: on the PR now.
Maria V: Thanks everyone — ping me here if you hit anything odd during lab tests.
